section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 2. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 13.2 | 6.6 | 500 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 15.6 | 7.8 | 500 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.6 | 6.3 | 500 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 13.6 | 6.8 | 500 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
